sources.title: Request for Feedback and arXiv cs.CL Endorsement
sources.snippet: Construction of a large-scale supervised instruction dataset from classical Arabic books. Continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning of a 4B-parameter Arabic language model. Methods for improving factual consistency and reducing hallucinations in answers. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multiple Islamic disciplines, including Tafsir, Fiqh, Hadith, and Aqeedah.
